name_reason: Compliant with naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix, battle core-table domain (data_fd2_battle_*), descriptor reflects subsystem (summon main animation) and data type (toggle = a flag/latch). No Ghidra address residue (no _53fe3 suffix); 'odd_even' / 'frame' are semantic, not addresses. Name accurately reflects use (mod-2 even-frame gate) and byte-flag type.
purpose: Mod-2 odd/even frame toggle that gates the even-frame state updates (frame advance, SFX, color rotation) of the main 12-slot summon-spell animation state machine.
logic_summary: Single byte runtime scratch used only by fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state (@0x26795). INIT (state_code 0) clears it to 0 before any read this run. Each TICK path (state_code 2/5/8) flips it via (val + 1) % 2, then reads it byte-wide as the even-frame gate: when 0, the per-slot frame-counter advance / frame-0 and frame-3 SFX chimes / frame-0xB color-rotation block runs; when 1 (odd frame), only the blit happens and state is held. Effectively halves the frame-advance rate so the animation steps every other tick.
datatype: uint8 (undefined1 in Ghidra; declared uint8 in src)
element_semantics: Scalar byte; value in {0,1}. 0 = even frame -> run state-update block; 1 = odd frame -> blit only, no state change. Reduced mod 2 on every flip.
notes: Sole accessor fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state has WRITE/READ_WRITE/READ xrefs at 0x26835/0x2687e/0x26884/0x26897/0x268f8 -> mutable, must stay non-const (declared plain uint8, correct). Zero-bss runtime scratch, on-disk image 0x00 (read_memory @0x53fe3 = all zeros). Adjacent siblings in same dispatch group: color_rotation_counter @0x53FE1, terminate_flag @0x53FE2. Source comment block (anisummn.c lines 895-908) already precise/accurate/ASCII; Ghidra data plate consistent with src -> left untouched. Source file not modified this symbol (comment already correct), so no clobber risk to anisummn.c.
